419:t_1:87.en:
$n
「It's not that. ...Your cheerfulness has helped me, and I'm grateful too.」

419:t_1:88.en:
$$ティティ$$
「You really can't forget about this Miss $$スズネ$$, can you...?」

419:t_1:89.en:
$n
「There's nothing to forget. Miss $$スズネ$$ isn't dead. I'll rescue her, no matter what.」

419:t_1:92.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...Um, $n... If I die, set me adrift in space...」

419:t_1:93.en:
$n
「What are you saying, all of a sudden...!?」

419:t_1:94.en:
$$ティティ$$
「It's not sudden, is it? Not in times like these.」

419:t_1:95.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I... always think about it. About what happens after I die.」

419:t_1:97.en:
$$ティティ$$
「It's a promise, $n. You turned me down, so you can at least grant me that much of a request.」

419:t_1:99.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Oh... I don't need any comforting, okay? That bid before was just something I tried saying, and I wasn't serious in the least.」

419:t_1:100.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Do your best, $n. I'll be cheering you on to get Miss $$スズネ$$ back.」

419:t_1:102.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I... have to get dinner ready... So, bye.」

419:t_1:109.en:
$$ランド$$
「We've been together a pretty long time now, you and me...」

419:t_1:110.en:
$$ランド$$
「Ever since the Boss disappeared, you, $$メール$$, and I have charged ahead like a three-person, four-legged race, but it looks like I still don't understand you...」

419:t_1:111.en:
$$ランド$$
「...Lend me your strength, $$ガンレオン$$.」

419:t_1:114.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Looks like he's agonizing over it. Says he can't bring out $$ガンレオン$$'s true power.」

419:t_1:115.en:
$$エイミー$$
「With that!? But $$ガンレオン$$ is already super strong...!」

419:t_1:116.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I don't really get it either, but according to $$ランド$$, it should be able to put out way, way more power.」

419:t_1:117.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So basically, he can't draw out the $$スフィア$$'s power.」

419:t_1:118.en:
$$エイミー$$
「The $$スフィア$$... That's the thing $$ガンレオン$$ and $$ジェニオン$$ have, right...」

419:t_1:119.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Hmm... I wonder if it's because he ran into such a huge power and shrank back from it...」

419:t_1:123.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Well... don't be so wary.」

419:t_1:124.en:
$$イアン$$
「We got together to lend a hand to a promising young man.」

419:t_1:125.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「With us here, you can feel like you're on a big ship... I mean, on $$ガルガンティア$$, $$レド$$.」

419:t_1:127.en:
$$サックス$$
「You're fighting as the pilot of $$チェインバー#robot$$ for now, but you intend to return to the Fleet someday, don't you?」

419:t_1:129.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Our idea is to give you a trade you can fall back on when that time comes.」

419:t_1:130.en:
$$ランド$$
「We're calling it Operation 'A Trade for $$レド$$'!」

419:t_1:131.en:
$$レド$$
「Too hot-blooded! And the operation name is way too on the nose!」

419:t_1:132.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Don't say that! $$ランド$$ and everyone are worried about you, $$レド$$.」

419:t_1:134.en:
$$ランド$$
「You bet! So that's why the $c maintenance crew is going to drill the ABCs of mechanics into you!」

419:t_1:135.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Though we also wanted a gofer.」

419:t_1:136.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Don't say unnecessary things, $$タクヤ$$!」

419:t_1:137.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「What are you talking about! You're the one who was happy that now there'd be someone lower than me on the totem pole, $$ピニオン$$!」

419:t_1:139.en:
$$サックス$$
「Oh, come on, it's fine. The Maintenance Crew and the Life Support Crew are always short-handed.」

419:t_1:140.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Right, right. A mechanic works his hands more than his mouth. Let's get today's maintenance done.」

419:t_1:141.en:
$$イアン$$
「So that's how it is. We're counting on you to lend a hand, $$レド$$.」

419:t_1:143.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「No, no. This isn't a combat unit, you know.」

419:t_1:144.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Right! We'll show you how it's done!」

419:t_1:145.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Then $$タクヤ$$, I'll have you check the mobile suits, and $$ピニオン$$, the ATs.」

419:t_1:148.en:
$$イアン$$
「Well, that's how it goes around here.」

419:t_1:149.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's go, $$レド$$. You're going to help everyone out.」

419:t_1:154.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...That old man really does love looking after the young ones.」

419:t_1:155.en:
$$マリ$$
「You're one to talk, Princess. You say all that, but you care about Puppy too.」

419:t_1:156.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I-it's not like that at all!」

419:t_1:157.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well... love and hate built up over a long, loooong time isn't so easy to digest, huh...」

419:t_1:162.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$アスカ$$... Before you joined us, I'd already heard about you... That you and I kind of overlap in character.」

419:t_1:163.en:
$$チコ$$
「But when I actually met you, it was different... ...You're more grown-up than I expected.」

419:t_1:166.en:
$$マリ$$
「That self-mocking way of putting it... Let me guess: you're refusing to become an adult, aren't you?」

419:t_1:168.en:
$$マリ$$
「But you can't stay an eternal boy forever... I bet that gap is going to make you suffer.」
